def paginate(items, page, per_page=10):
    if page < 1:
        return []
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    end = start + per_page
    return items[start:end]
```

def paginate(items, page, per_page=10):
    if page < 1 or page * per_page > len(items):
        return []
    start = (page - 1) * per_page
    return items[start:start + per_page]
```
